fix.item: Category, File extension and File size were always empty.

addition.item: Link and Download Link fields, through the document's DOCman menu item (as DOCman's own documents module; without a DOCman menu item there is no link).
Image (DOCman thumbnail, resizable by YOOtheme), Icon Name, Created and Modified dates, Author, Downloads, File Type, MIME Type and a readable File Size such as "4.8 MB".
Dates use YOOtheme's date format options; Title and Description can be shortened.
Documents list: choose categories from a list (several at once), include child categories, and order by newest, oldest, title, downloads, last modified or DOCman ordering.

change.item: DOCman API errors are written to the Joomla log (category "elemen") instead of being silently ignored.

addition.item: Initial DOCman dynamic content source for one document and document lists.
Published documents are fetched through the DOCman PHP API with the current user's permissions.
